description: Auto restart on update and the version Baude and Record run: Settings' rows for them, and the toast after an update; the phone's own update words (its Settings row for metered networks, what it says when an update can't go ahead).

messages.no_upstream: Not a git checkout following a branch: nothing to update from
messages.updated_commits: .input {$n :number} .match $n one {{{$app} updated: {$n} new commit}} * {{{$app} updated: {$n} new commits}}
messages.metered_subtitle: From the Baude site as they're published; otherwise once Update's tapped
messages.closes_to_update: {$app} closes to update: open it again once it has
messages.cant_read: Can't update: the new version can't be read
messages.not_this_app: Can't update: the new version isn't a build of this app
messages.other_key: Can't update: the new version is signed with another key
